nodes.name: Alert dispatch webhook
nodes.notes: Generic, reusable sub-workflow: every other workflow in this library that needs to raise an internal alert (W1.1/W1.2's generation-failure alert, W0.1/every workflow's errorWorkflow setting) should call THIS webhook rather than hitting Google Chat/SMS directly - one place to change delivery logic. Body contract: {severity: 'info'|'warning'|'critical', source: string (which workflow/step raised it), message: string}. Not itself blocked on an undecided threshold - W2.4's 'documented only' status in the previous version of this catalog was about WHAT triggers an alert (thresholds like 'high-value lead', 'overdue'), not the dispatch mechanism itself, which needed no such decision.

nodes.name: Critical?
nodes.notes: ASSUMED routing rule, not specified by the brief: 'critical' goes to Google Chat AND SMS, 'warning'/'info' go to Google Chat only. Reasonable default (SMS for urgent-enough-to-interrupt, Google Chat for everything worth a record), but worth confirming - the brief just says 'Slack/SMS via n8n' (written before the switch to Google Chat) without a routing rule between the two channels either way.

nodes.name: Send to Google Chat
nodes.notes: Switched from Slack per Jonathan's request. Google Chat's incoming-webhook API takes the same minimal shape as Slack's ({text: string} POSTed as JSON) - no structural change needed, just the target URL. GOOGLE_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL is the full webhook URL a Google Chat space's 'Apps & integrations -> Webhooks' screen generates (already includes its own key/token query params - paste the whole URL, not just a base). Smaller gap than the Slack version was: Google Chat rides on the same Google Workspace domain already assumed elsewhere in this system (Drive API in 02 - Launch Checklist, and the Command Center's Cloudflare Access policy is 'anyone on the @orbitaiautomation.com Workspace domain') - still not literally listed as its own checklist line item, but far more likely to already exist than a standalone Slack workspace would.

nodes.name: Send SMS (critical only)
nodes.notes: Still a real gap, unlike Google Chat: no SMS provider (Twilio or otherwise) appears ANYWHERE in 02 - Launch Checklist - not even as a deferred/later item the way Telnyx and Documenso are. If SMS alerts are actually wanted for go-live, a provider account needs adding to the credential set; until then this stays a named placeholder with no real vendor decided, not just no key yet.
